author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Smart line-breaking for math solutions and formulas: prevented horizontal overflows by automatically breaking lines at logical transitions ('\Rightarrow', '=', colons '៖', full stops '។', and Khmer 'នាំឱ្យ/នាំឲ្យ'), allowing KaTeX to wrap cleanly and adding responsive overflow controls across quiz explanations and question bank solutions.
